svg.title: FIELD / 4 - battery reserve and Raspberry Pi 4 mounting interface
svg.text: Battery reserve and Raspberry Pi 4 mounting interface
Unverified pack allowance; measure the actual battery
Scale 1:2 on A3; no cable/connector fit implied
Connector exits, padding and strap thickness must be checked on the real pack.
Reserve is centered at world X0, Y0. Light outline is an illustrative battery only.
Top view / scale 1:1 on A3 / all coordinates are world XY
Seat top Z118; PCB thickness 1.6. Four M2.5 fasteners.
Pitch is 58 along Y x 49 along X. Boss bores are printed clearances.
Verify the actual board revision, screw length, plugs and cooler before assembly.
Axes: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up. Board origin is its lower-X/lower-Y corner.
All dimensions mm. Dimensions govern; do not scale screenshots. A3 landscape PDF is vector artwork.
